prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1326; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints centered on low back pain and muscular tightness radiating into the paraspinal region, and the mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from history or records reviewed. Over the course of ten visits, the patient received manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle guarding and reduced lumbar range of motion, which support a soft tissue strain, while neurological screening and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type, with gradual improvement noted toward the final visits. Billing review identified one service recorded twice on the same date; the provider acknowledged the second entry was a duplicate and has noted it for correction. Patient was discharged with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
